fixed: With Auto-convert all discouraged terms on, a custom dialect's own role words are no longer swapped for the other role: in a dialect whose role is "Raven", a note saying "Ravens cross" no longer shows as the other role crossing.
Restoring a backup that holds a setting nested far deeper than the app ever writes no longer stops part-way and reports failure: that setting is skipped and the rest of the restore applies.
When applying settings fails during a backup restore and Retry succeeds, the message now says how many problems the restore skipped, instead of only "Settings applied."
Removing a device under Device Sync's Other devices now also removes its record of what that device's app can read, on every device, instead of leaving it to sync forever.

added: `jsonNestedDeeperThan`: whether a JSON value nests lists and maps deeper than a limit, checked without recursion. `userGlossaryPayloadDeeperThan` now uses it.
fixed: The renderer's discouraged-term display keeps a dialect's claimed role words as written, as glossary canonicalization already does.
`difficulty_levels.id` has its own privacy classification note: a shipped level id or a UUID, not an opaque key.
